name: Dal Bhat
description: Traditional Nepali staple of steamed rice served with lentil soup.
steps: 1. Wash and boil rice until fluffy.
2. Boil red lentils with turmeric until soft.
3. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil until golden.
4. Add tomato and chili, cook until mushy.
5. Mix tempering into lentils. Serve over rice with coriander.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Slow-cooked spiced chicken curry in a tomato-onion gravy.
steps: 1. Marinate chicken with garlic, ginger, chili for 30 min.
2. Fry onion until golden.
3. Add marinated chicken, cook on high heat.
4. Add tomato and potato.
5. Simmer 30 min until oil separates. Garnish with coriander.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Quick stir-fried rice with fresh vegetables and egg.
steps: 1. Cook rice and let cool completely.
2. Scramble egg in wok and set aside.
3. Stir-fry garlic, onion, carrot, cabbage, capsicum.
4. Add cold rice, toss on high heat.
5. Mix in egg and onion leaves. Season and serve.

name: Aloo Gobi
description: Dry stir-fry of potato and cauliflower with aromatic spices.
steps: 1. Cube potato and break cauliflower into florets.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger until golden.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook until soft.
4. Add potato and cauliflower, cover and cook 20 min.
5. Garnish with fresh coriander.

name: Beaten Rice Snack (Chiura Bhuja)
description: Quick Nepali snack of beaten rice tossed with vegetables.
steps: 1. Rinse beaten rice briefly and drain.
2. Mix with finely chopped onion, tomato, cucumber.
3. Add chili and coriander.
4. Squeeze lemon juice over and toss. Serve immediately.

name: Egg Bhurji
description: Spiced scrambled eggs cooked with onion, tomato, and chili.
steps: 1. Beat eggs with salt.
2. Fry onion, garlic, chili and capsicum.
3. Add tomato, cook until soft.
4. Pour in eggs and scramble continuously.
5. Garnish with coriander. Serve with bread.

name: Chowmein Noodles Stir-fry
description: Popular Nepali street-style chowmein with vegetables and chicken.
steps: 1. Boil noodles until just cooked, drain and toss with oil.
2. Stir-fry garlic and chicken on high heat.
3. Add onion, carrot, cabbage, capsicum.
4. Toss in noodles and stir-fry 3 min.
5. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Thukpa Noodle Soup
description: Hearty Tibetan-style noodle soup popular in Nepal.
steps: 1. Boil chicken with garlic and ginger to make broth.
2. Shred chicken and return to broth.
3. Add carrot, cabbage, onion to broth and simmer.
4. Add thukpa noodles and cook until tender.
5. Serve hot garnished with coriander.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Cubed cottage cheese in a smooth spinach and spice gravy.
steps: 1. Blanch spinach and blend smooth.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in butter.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook until soft.
4. Add spinach puree and simmer 5 min.
5. Add paneer cubes and simmer 5 more min.

name: Aloo ko Tarkari (Potato Curry)
description: Simple everyday Nepali potato curry with mustard oil.
steps: 1. Cube potatoes and par-boil.
2. Fry onion in oil until golden.
3. Add garlic, ginger, chili and tomato.
4. Add potatoes and 1 cup water.
5. Simmer 15 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Fish Curry
description: Tangy fish curry cooked with tomato and fresh spices.
steps: 1. Marinate fish with lemon, salt, chili.
2. Shallow fry fish and set aside.
3. Fry onion, garlic, ginger.
4. Add tomato and cook until oil separates.
5. Add fish and simmer 10 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Mixed Vegetable Curry
description: Hearty mixed vegetable curry with seasonal produce.
steps: 1. Cut all vegetables into similar-sized pieces.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger until golden.
3. Add tomato and cook until mushy.
4. Add harder vegetables first, softer ones later.
5. Simmer until all vegetables are tender.

name: Mushroom Stir-fry
description: Quick garlic mushroom stir-fry with onion and chili.
steps: 1. Slice mushrooms and capsicum.
2. Fry garlic in oil until golden.
3. Add onion and capsicum, stir-fry 2 min.
4. Add mushrooms and chili, cook on high heat.
5. Garnish with onion leaves and coriander.

name: Sisnu ko Saag (Stinging Nettle Greens)
description: Traditional Nepali nettle greens sauteed with garlic.
steps: 1. Blanch nettles with gloves on, then chop.
2. Fry garlic and onion in oil.
3. Add chili and tomato, cook 5 min.
4. Add blanched nettles and stir-fry.
5. Season and serve with rice.

name: Chickpea Curry (Chana Tarkari)
description: Protein-rich chickpea curry with tomato-onion base.
steps: 1. Soak chickpeas overnight and pressure cook until soft.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook until thick.
4. Add chickpeas and 1 cup water.
5. Simmer 10 min. Finish with lemon and coriander.

name: Lapsi ko Achar (Nepali Hog Plum Pickle)
description: Sweet-sour Nepali fruit pickle made from hog plum.
steps: 1. Boil lapsi until soft, remove seeds and mash pulp.
2. Fry garlic, ginger and chili in oil.
3. Add lapsi pulp and cook on low heat 20 min.
4. Adjust sweetness and sourness to taste.
5. Cool and store. Serve as condiment.

name: Karkalo ko Tarkari (Taro Leaf Curry)
description: Traditional Nepali taro leaf curry with lentils.
steps: 1. Wash taro leaves thoroughly and chop.
2. Boil black lentils until half cooked.
3. Fry onion, garlic, chili in oil.
4. Add tomato, cook until soft.
5. Add taro leaves, taro root and lentils. Simmer 20 min.

name: Nutrela (Soya Chunks) Curry
description: Protein-packed soya chunks cooked in spiced tomato gravy.
steps: 1. Soak soya chunks in hot water 15 min, squeeze dry.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger until golden.
3. Add capsicum, tomato and chili.
4. Add soya chunks and stir-fry on high heat.
5. Simmer 10 min. Serve with rice or bread.

name: Fiddlehead Fern Stir-fry (Niguro Tarkari)
description: Seasonal Nepali fiddlehead ferns stir-fried with garlic and chili.
steps: 1. Clean ferns and blanch in salted water.
2. Fry garlic and onion in oil.
3. Add chili and tomato, cook 5 min.
4. Add ferns and toss on high heat 5 min.
5. Season and serve with rice.

name: Tofu and Vegetable Stir-fry
description: Crispy tofu stir-fried with colourful vegetables.
steps: 1. Press and cube tofu, pan-fry until golden.
2. Stir-fry garlic and ginger.
3. Add carrot, broccoli, capsicum in order of firmness.
4. Toss in tofu and season.
5. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Beef Stew
description: Slow-cooked beef with root vegetables in rich broth.
steps: 1. Cut beef into cubes and brown in batches.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in the same pot.
3. Add tomato and chili.
4. Return beef with water, simmer 40 min.
5. Add potato and carrot, cook 20 more min.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Creamy avocado spread on toast with fresh toppings.
steps: 1. Toast bread slices.
2. Mash avocado with lemon juice and chili.
3. Spread generously on toast.
4. Top with sliced tomato and a poached or fried egg.
5. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Green Lentil Soup
description: Wholesome green lentil soup with fresh vegetables.
steps: 1. Boil green lentils until tender.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add carrot and lentils, simmer 15 min.
5. Garnish with coriander.

name: Beef Achar (Spicy Beef Pickle)
description: Spicy slow-cooked beef pickle, a Nepali party favourite.
steps: 1. Cut Beef into small pieces.
2. Dry-roast and grind chili.
3. Fry garlic, ginger, onion until golden.
4. Add Beef and cook on high heat.
5. Add tomato, chili paste and lemon. Cook until dry.

name: Fruit Salad
description: Refreshing mixed fruit salad with mint dressing.
steps: 1. Wash and chop all fruits into bite-sized pieces.
2. Combine in a large bowl.
3. Squeeze lemon juice over to prevent browning.
4. Tear fresh mint leaves on top.
5. Toss gently and refrigerate 15 min before serving.

name: Minced Meat Curry
description: Spiced minced meat cooked with peas and tomato.
steps: 1. Fry onion, garlic, ginger until golden.
2. Add minced meat and cook on high heat until brown.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook until oil separates.
4. Add diced potato and water.
5. Simmer 15 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Crab Meat Stir-fry
description: Fragrant crab meat stir-fried with ginger, garlic and vegetables.
steps: 1. Fry garlic and ginger until fragrant.
2. Add onion and capsicum, stir-fry 2 min.
3. Add crab meat and chili, toss on high heat.
4. Season to taste.
5. Garnish with onion leaves and coriander.

name: Sajjyun ko Munta Soup (Moringa Soup)
description: Nutritious moringa drumstick soup with lentils.
steps: 1. Boil red lentils until very soft.
2. Cut drumsticks into 3-inch pieces.
3. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
4. Add tomato and lentils, simmer 10 min.
5. Add drumsticks and cook 10 more min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Kimchi Fried Rice
description: Tangy and spicy kimchi fried rice topped with egg.
steps: 1. Fry garlic and onion in sesame oil.
2. Add kimchi and stir-fry until caramelised.
3. Add cold rice and toss on high heat.
4. Push rice aside, fry egg sunny side up.
5. Plate rice topped with egg and onion leaves.

name: Seaweed Tofu Soup
description: Light and comforting seaweed soup with silken tofu.
steps: 1. Soak seaweed in water until soft, drain.
2. Fry garlic and ginger briefly.
3. Add water and bring to boil.
4. Add seaweed and silken tofu cubes.
5. Simmer 10 min. Top with onion leaves.

name: Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy banana pancakes made with egg and wheat flour.
steps: 1. Mash banana thoroughly in a bowl.
2. Add eggs and whisk together.
3. Fold in wheat flour to form batter.
4. Cook spoonfuls in buttered pan on medium heat.
5. Serve with sliced strawberries.

name: Pumpkin Soup
description: Creamy roasted pumpkin soup with ginger and garlic.
steps: 1. Cube pumpkin and roast with oil until golden.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in pot.
3. Add roasted pumpkin and carrot.
4. Add water and simmer 20 min.
5. Blend smooth. Garnish with coriander.

name: Red Beans and Rice
description: Creamy red beans in spiced gravy served over rice.
steps: 1. Soak red beans overnight and pressure cook until soft.
2. Cook rice separately.
3. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
4. Add tomato and chili, cook until thick.
5. Add beans and simmer 10 min. Serve over rice with coriander.

name: Bottle Gourd Curry
description: Light and healthy bottle gourd curry in thin tomato gravy.
steps: 1. Peel and cube bottle gourd.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add bottle gourd and water, cover and cook 15 min.
5. Garnish with coriander.

name: Sausage and Egg Breakfast
description: Classic breakfast plate with sausages, fried egg, and tomato.
steps: 1. Pan-fry sausages until cooked through.
2. Fry egg to preference.
3. Sauté onion and capsicum.
4. Halve tomatoes and grill in the same pan.
5. Serve everything on plate with toasted bread.

name: Tofu Scramble
description: Vegan scrambled tofu with vegetables as an egg substitute.
steps: 1. Crumble firm tofu in a bowl.
2. Fry garlic, onion, capsicum until soft.
3. Add crumbled tofu and chili.
4. Cook stirring for 5 min until dry.
5. Top with tomato and onion leaves.

name: Broccoli and Cheese Bake
description: Tender broccoli baked under a golden cheese crust.
steps: 1. Blanch broccoli florets until just tender.
2. Fry garlic and onion in butter.
3. Layer broccoli in baking dish.
4. Top with grated cheese and breadcrumbs.
5. Bake at 200°C for 20 min until golden.

name: Cucumber Raita
description: Cool yogurt condiment with cucumber and fresh mint.
steps: 1. Grate or finely dice cucumber, squeeze out excess water.
2. Mix with yogurt.
3. Add minced garlic and chili.
4. Add mint and coriander leaves.
5. Squeeze lemon and mix. Chill before serving.

name: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Stew
description: Warming stew combining sweet potato with protein-rich chickpeas.
steps: 1. Cube sweet potato.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger until golden.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook until thick.
4. Add sweet potato and chickpeas with water.
5. Simmer 20 min until sweet potato is soft. Garnish with coriander.

name: Jack Fruit Curry
description: Tender young jackfruit cooked in spiced gravy.
steps: 1. Boil young jackfruit until tender, drain.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger until golden.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 10 min.
4. Add jackfruit and potato.
5. Simmer 20 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Okra Stir-fry (Bhindi Tarkari)
description: Crispy dry stir-fried okra with spices.
steps: 1. Wash and dry okra completely, slice into rounds.
2. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
3. Add okra and chili, do NOT stir too much.
4. Cook on medium heat until okra is not slimy.
5. Add tomato last minute. Garnish with coriander.

name: Garden Cress Saag
description: Nutritious garden cress greens lightly stir-fried with garlic.
steps: 1. Wash and roughly chop garden cress.
2. Fry garlic and onion in oil.
3. Add chili and tomato, cook 5 min.
4. Add garden cress and toss well.
5. Cook 5 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Bamboo Shoot Pickle (Tama Achar)
description: Fermented bamboo shoot pickle, a Nepali kitchen staple.
steps: 1. Rinse fermented bamboo shoots well.
2. Roast and grind chili.
3. Fry garlic and ginger in oil.
4. Add bamboo shoots and chili paste.
5. Cook until dry. Finish with fresh coriander.

name: Palungo ko Saag (Nepali Spinach)
description: Simple Nepali spinach sauteed with garlic and chili.
steps: 1. Wash palungo thoroughly.
2. Fry garlic and onion in oil.
3. Add chili and tomato, cook 3 min.
4. Add palungo and toss.
5. Cook until wilted. Serve immediately.

name: Ash Gourd Curry (Kubhindo Tarkari)
description: Mild and comforting ash gourd curry.
steps: 1. Peel and cube ash gourd.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add ash gourd and water.
5. Simmer 15 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Ham and Cheese Sandwich
description: Toasted ham and cheese sandwich with fresh vegetables.
steps: 1. Layer ham and cheese on bread.
2. Add sliced tomato and cucumber.
3. Top with onion leaves.
4. Close sandwich and toast in pan or sandwich press.
5. Cut diagonally and serve.

name: Papaya Salad
description: Shredded green papaya salad with lime dressing.
steps: 1. Shred unripe papaya and cut long beans.
2. Pound garlic and chili in mortar.
3. Add tomato and pound lightly.
4. Mix in papaya and long beans.
5. Dress with lime juice. Toss and serve.

name: Corn Soup
description: Sweet and light creamed corn soup with egg.
steps: 1. Blend half the corn, keep other half whole.
2. Fry garlic, ginger and onion.
3. Add blended and whole corn with water.
4. Bring to boil, slowly drizzle beaten egg while stirring.
5. Garnish with onion leaves and coriander.

name: Pointed Gourd Curry (Chuche Karela)
description: Lightly spiced pointed gourd curry cooked Nepali style.
steps: 1. Scrape and slice pointed gourd.
2. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add pointed gourd, cover and cook 15 min.
5. Garnish with coriander.

name: Tree Tomato Chutney (Rukh Tamatar)
description: Tangy roasted tree tomato chutney, a Nepali classic.
steps: 1. Roast tree tomatoes directly on flame until charred.
2. Peel and blend with garlic, ginger, chili.
3. Season to taste.
4. Mix in fresh coriander and mint.
5. Serve as dip or condiment with rice.

name: Artichoke and Potato Stew
description: Tender artichoke hearts with potato in herbed broth.
steps: 1. Trim artichokes to hearts and halve.
2. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add artichoke and potato with water.
5. Simmer 25 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Bacon and Egg Fried Rice
description: Smoky bacon bits fried with rice, egg and vegetables.
steps: 1. Fry bacon until crispy, set aside.
2. Scramble egg in the same pan.
3. Fry garlic and onion.
4. Add cold rice and cabbage, toss on high heat.
5. Mix in bacon and egg. Top with onion leaves.

name: Beetroot Salad
description: Roasted beetroot salad with fresh onion and lemon dressing.
steps: 1. Boil or roast beetroot until tender, cube.
2. Thinly slice onion and cucumber.
3. Combine beetroot, onion and cucumber.
4. Dress with lemon juice and chili.
5. Garnish with coriander and serve.

name: Brinjal Bharta
description: Roasted and mashed brinjal with spices and tomato.
steps: 1. Roast brinjal whole over flame until charred.
2. Peel and mash the flesh.
3. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
4. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
5. Mix in mashed brinjal. Garnish with coriander.

name: Broad Beans Stir-fry (Bakullo)
description: Young broad beans stir-fried with garlic and tomato.
steps: 1. Shell broad beans.
2. Fry garlic and onion in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add broad beans and stir-fry 8 min.
5. Garnish with coriander.

name: Cassava Chips (Ghar Tarul)
description: Crispy fried cassava chips seasoned with chili and lime.
steps: 1. Peel cassava and slice thinly.
2. Fry in oil until golden and crispy.
3. Drain on paper towels.
4. Toss with minced garlic, chili and lime juice.
5. Garnish with coriander and serve immediately.

name: Chayote Curry (Iskus Tarkari)
description: Mild chayote curry cooked Nepali style with tomato and spices.
steps: 1. Peel and cube chayote.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add chayote and water, cover.
5. Cook 15 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Green Soyabean Stir-fry (Hariyo Bhatmas)
description: Quick stir-fried green soybeans with garlic and chili.
steps: 1. Blanch green soybeans in salted water.
2. Fry garlic in oil until golden.
3. Add soybeans and chili, toss on high heat.
4. Season to taste.
5. Finish with lime juice and onion leaves.

name: Moringa Leaf Stir-fry
description: Nutritious moringa leaves quickly stir-fried with garlic.
steps: 1. Strip moringa leaves from stems.
2. Fry garlic and onion in oil.
3. Add chili and tomato, cook 3 min.
4. Add moringa leaves and toss well.
5. Cook 5 min and serve with rice.

name: Radish Pickle (Mula ko Achar)
description: Crunchy fermented Nepali radish pickle.
steps: 1. Julienne or grate radish, salt and rest 10 min.
2. Squeeze out water from radish.
3. Roast and grind chili, mix with garlic and ginger.
4. Combine radish with chili mix.
5. Dress with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Snake Gourd Curry (Chichindo)
description: Light snake gourd curry in a thin tomato gravy.
steps: 1. Peel and slice snake gourd into rounds.
2. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add snake gourd and water.
5. Simmer 15 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Soyabean Curry (Bhatmas Tarkari)
description: Hearty Nepali soyabean curry, rich in protein.
steps: 1. Soak soyabeans overnight, pressure cook until soft.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook until thick.
4. Add cooked soyabeans and water.
5. Simmer 10 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Sponge Gourd Stir-fry (Ghiraula)
description: Tender sponge gourd stir-fried with spices.
steps: 1. Peel and slice sponge gourd.
2. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
4. Add sponge gourd, cover and cook 10 min.
5. Garnish with coriander.

name: Turnip and Potato Curry
description: Earthy turnip and potato curry with mustard seeds.
steps: 1. Cube turnip and potato similarly.
2. Fry onion, garlic, ginger in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook until mushy.
4. Add turnip and potato with water.
5. Simmer 20 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Chicken Kabsa
description: Saudi national dish of spiced rice cooked with whole chicken.
steps: 1. Brown chicken pieces in oil.
2. Fry onion and garlic until golden.
3. Add tomato and carrot, cook 5 min.
4. Add chicken, water and spices, simmer 30 min.
5. Add washed rice to the broth, cover and cook until done. Garnish with coriander and lemon.

name: Beef Kabsa
description: Slow-cooked beef and spiced rice, a Gulf classic.
steps: 1. Cut beef into large chunks and brown in oil.
2. Fry onion and garlic until golden.
3. Add tomato, carrot and beef, cover with water.
4. Simmer 60 min until beef is tender.
5. Cook rice in the broth. Serve beef over rice.

name: Hummus
description: Creamy blended chickpea dip with garlic and lemon.
steps: 1. Drain and rinse cooked chickpeas.
2. Blend chickpeas with garlic until smooth.
3. Add lemon juice and blend again.
4. Season with salt.
5. Drizzle with oil and garnish with chili and coriander.

name: Fattoush Salad
description: Levantine salad of fresh vegetables with toasted bread.
steps: 1. Toast bread pieces until crispy.
2. Chop tomato, cucumber, onion and capsicum.
3. Combine vegetables in a bowl.
4. Dress with lemon juice and oil.
5. Add toasted bread, mint and coriander. Toss and serve.

name: Tabbouleh
description: Fresh herb salad with wheat, tomato and lemon.
steps: 1. Soak cracked wheat in cold water 20 min, drain.
2. Finely chop tomato, onion leaves, mint and coriander.
3. Combine wheat with all vegetables and herbs.
4. Dress generously with lemon juice and oil.
5. Chill 30 min before serving.

name: Chicken Shawarma
description: Marinated spiced chicken sliced thin and served in flatbread.
steps: 1. Marinate chicken with garlic, lemon and spices overnight.
2. Roast or grill chicken until charred and cooked.
3. Slice thinly.
4. Warm flatbread and layer with chicken.
5. Add tomato, cucumber and onion. Drizzle with garlic sauce.

name: Minced Meat Kofta
description: Spiced minced meat skewers grilled to perfection.
steps: 1. Mix minced meat with grated onion, garlic, chili and coriander.
2. Shape into long sausages on skewers.
3. Grill on high heat turning often until cooked.
4. Serve with sliced tomato and onion.
5. Squeeze lemon over and garnish with coriander.

name: Arabian Lentil Soup
description: Velvety orange lentil soup spiced with cumin and lemon.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
2. Add carrot and tomato, cook 5 min.
3. Add red lentils and water, bring to boil.
4. Simmer 20 min until lentils are very soft.
5. Blend smooth. Squeeze lemon over and garnish with coriander.

name: Chicken Mandi
description: Yemeni slow-cooked spiced chicken and rice with smoky finish.
steps: 1. Marinate chicken with spices and garlic.
2. Cook chicken in pot with onion, tomato and water until tender.
3. Remove chicken, cook rice in the broth.
4. Place chicken over cooked rice.
5. Smoke briefly with charcoal. Serve with coriander and lemon.

name: Falafel
description: Crispy deep-fried chickpea patties with fresh herbs.
steps: 1. Soak chickpeas overnight, drain well.
2. Blend with garlic, onion, herbs and chili, do not over-blend.
3. Shape into small patties.
4. Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crispy.
5. Serve with lemon wedges and fresh coriander.

name: Baba Ganoush
description: Smoky roasted brinjal dip with garlic and lemon.
steps: 1. Char whole brinjals over open flame until fully blackened.
2. Peel and drain flesh in colander.
3. Mash with minced garlic and lemon juice.
4. Season well.
5. Garnish with diced tomato, onion and coriander.

name: Chicken and Okra Soup
description: Egyptian-style green soup with chicken and garlic.
steps: 1. Boil chicken to make broth, shred meat.
2. Fry garlic until golden.
3. Add sliced okra and tomato to broth.
4. Add chicken and garlic, simmer 15 min.
5. Serve over rice, garnish with coriander and lemon.

name: Chicken Machboos
description: Bahraini spiced rice and chicken with caramelised onion.
steps: 1. Brown chicken in oil, remove.
2. Fry onion until deep brown and caramelised.
3. Add garlic, ginger, tomato and spices.
4. Return chicken, add water and simmer 30 min.
5. Cook rice in broth. Serve topped with crispy onion and coriander.

name: Stuffed Capsicum
description: Capsicums filled with spiced minced meat and rice.
steps: 1. Cut tops off capsicums and remove seeds.
2. Mix minced meat with half-cooked rice, onion, garlic and spices.
3. Fill capsicums with mixture.
4. Place in baking dish with tomato sauce.
5. Bake covered at 180 C for 40 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Arabian Beef Stew (Maraq)
description: Light Yemeni bone broth stew with vegetables.
steps: 1. Brown beef in pot.
2. Add onion, garlic and water, bring to boil.
3. Simmer 40 min to build flavour.
4. Add potato, carrot and tomato.
5. Cook 20 min more. Serve with lemon and coriander.

name: Chicken with Wheat
description: Levantine roasted green wheat cooked with spiced chicken.
steps: 1. Brown chicken with onion and garlic.
2. Add water and simmer chicken 30 min.
3. Remove chicken and add cracked wheat to broth.
4. Add carrot and cook until wheat is tender.
5. Top with chicken pieces. Serve with lemon and coriander.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and capsicum sauce.
steps: 1. Fry onion, garlic and capsicum in oil.
2. Add tomato and chili, cook until thick sauce forms.
3. Make wells in the sauce.
4. Crack eggs into the wells.
5. Cover and cook until whites are set. Garnish with coriander.

name: Fatteh
description: Layered dish of crispy bread, chickpeas, and yogurt.
steps: 1. Toast bread pieces until crispy.
2. Warm chickpeas with garlic and spices.
3. Make sauce from tomato and chili.
4. Mix garlic with lemon juice.
5. Layer bread, chickpeas, tomato sauce then garlic dressing. Garnish with coriander.

name: Vegetable Couscous
description: North African steamed wheat with a rich vegetable stew.
steps: 1. Prepare couscous-style wheat by steaming.
2. Fry onion and garlic.
3. Add carrot, potato and pumpkin.
4. Add tomato and water, simmer 25 min.
5. Serve vegetable stew over wheat, garnish with coriander.

name: Chicken Tagine
description: Moroccan-style slow-braised chicken with root vegetables.
steps: 1. Brown chicken pieces.
2. Layer onion, garlic and ginger in tagine.
3. Add chicken, carrot, potato and tomato.
4. Add lemon and water.
5. Cover tightly and cook on low heat 60 min.

name: Arabian Fish with Rice
description: Gulf-style baked spiced fish served over saffron rice.
steps: 1. Marinate fish with garlic, lemon and chili.
2. Fry onion, add tomato and cook into sauce.
3. Add fish and braise 15 min.
4. Cook rice in spiced broth.
5. Serve fish over rice with coriander.

name: Mutabal
description: Creamy roasted brinjal salad with garlic and tomato.
steps: 1. Roast whole brinjal over flame until charred.
2. Peel and drain flesh.
3. Chop coarsely with garlic.
4. Mix with lemon juice and chili.
5. Top with diced tomato and onion. Garnish with coriander.

name: Arabian Chicken Soup
description: Comforting Arabian chicken soup with root vegetables.
steps: 1. Place chicken in pot with onion, garlic and ginger.
2. Cover with water and bring to boil.
3. Skim foam, add carrot and potato.
4. Simmer 30 min until all is tender.
5. Serve hot with lemon and fresh coriander.

name: Baked Pasta with Minced Meat
description: Egyptian baked pasta with minced meat and white sauce.
steps: 1. Cook wheat pasta until al dente.
2. Brown minced meat with onion, garlic and tomato.
3. Make white sauce with butter, flour and water.
4. Layer pasta, meat, then white sauce in baking dish.
5. Top with cheese and beaten egg. Bake at 190 C for 30 min.

name: Stuffed Tomatoes
description: Tomatoes filled with spiced rice and minced meat.
steps: 1. Hollow out tomatoes, reserving the flesh.
2. Mix minced meat with half-cooked rice, onion, garlic and coriander.
3. Fill tomatoes with meat mixture.
4. Place in baking dish with reserved tomato flesh.
5. Bake at 180 C for 30 min. Drizzle with lemon.

name: Chicken with Okra
description: Slow-cooked chicken and okra in tomato sauce.
steps: 1. Brown chicken pieces in oil.
2. Fry onion and garlic, add tomato.
3. Return chicken and add water.
4. Simmer 25 min then add whole okra.
5. Cook 15 more min. Finish with lemon and coriander.

name: Cheese and Egg Flatbread
description: Griddle-cooked flatbread stuffed with egg and cheese.
steps: 1. Beat eggs with salt.
2. Grate cheese.
3. Lay flatbread on hot griddle.
4. Pour egg over one side, add cheese and chili.
5. Fold and cook until golden on both sides. Top with tomato and onion leaves.

name: Stuffed Cabbage Rolls
description: Cabbage leaves stuffed with rice and meat in tomato broth.
steps: 1. Blanch cabbage leaves until pliable.
2. Mix minced meat with rice, garlic and coriander.
3. Roll meat mixture in cabbage leaves tightly.
4. Layer in pot with tomato and garlic.
5. Add water, cover and cook 45 min on low heat. Squeeze lemon before serving.

name: Arabian Chickpea Stew
description: Hearty spiced chickpea stew with potato and tomato.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
2. Add tomato and chili, cook 5 min.
3. Add diced potato and chickpeas.
4. Pour in water and simmer 20 min.
5. Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Grilled Chicken with Garlic Sauce
description: Chargrilled chicken served with a tangy garlic dip.
steps: 1. Marinate chicken with garlic, lemon and chili.
2. Grill on high heat until charred and cooked through.
3. Blend garlic with lemon juice to make sauce.
4. Slice chicken.
5. Serve with garlic sauce, sliced onion and coriander.

name: Potato and Egg Tagine
description: Moroccan-style potato and egg bake in spiced tomato sauce.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
2. Add tomato and chili, cook into thick sauce.
3. Add sliced potato and cook until tender.
4. Make wells, crack eggs in.
5. Cover and cook until eggs are set. Garnish with coriander.

name: Spinach and Lentil Soup
description: Nourishing soup of red lentils and spinach with lemon.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
2. Add red lentils and water, bring to boil.
3. Simmer 15 min until lentils are soft.
4. Add spinach and tomato, cook 5 min.
5. Squeeze lemon over. Garnish with coriander.

name: Arabian Spiced Fish Rice
description: Spiced fish cooked into fragrant rice.
steps: 1. Marinate fish with garlic, ginger and lemon.
2. Fry onion until golden, add tomato.
3. Add fish and cook briefly.
4. Add rice and water, cover and cook until done.
5. Fluff rice and serve with coriander and lemon.

name: Kofta in Tomato Sauce
description: Minced meat kofta simmered in spiced tomato sauce.
steps: 1. Shape minced meat with onion and coriander into oval kofta.
2. Grill kofta until browned.
3. Fry garlic, onion and capsicum.
4. Add tomato and chili, make a thick sauce.
5. Add kofta to sauce and simmer 10 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Arabian Vegetable Soup
description: Simple aromatic vegetable broth with chickpeas.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
2. Add carrot and potato, stir 3 min.
3. Add tomato, chickpeas and water.
4. Simmer 25 min until vegetables are soft.
5. Finish with lemon and coriander.

name: Flatbread with Hummus
description: Warm flatbread served with chickpea dip and fresh vegetables.
steps: 1. Blend chickpeas with garlic and lemon into hummus.
2. Slice tomato, cucumber and onion.
3. Warm flatbread.
4. Spread hummus on bread.
5. Top with vegetables and coriander.

name: Beef and Carrot Stew
description: Slow-cooked tender beef with sweet carrot in rich broth.
steps: 1. Brown beef in oil.
2. Fry onion and garlic, add tomato.
3. Add beef with water and simmer 40 min.
4. Add carrot and potato.
5. Cook 20 min. Serve with coriander and lemon.

name: Arabian Chicken Salad
description: Poached chicken tossed with vegetables in lemon dressing.
steps: 1. Poach chicken until cooked, let cool and shred.
2. Dice tomato, cucumber and onion.
3. Make dressing with lemon juice and garlic.
4. Toss chicken and vegetables with dressing.
5. Garnish with mint and coriander.

name: Rice Stuffed Chicken
description: Whole chicken stuffed with spiced rice and roasted.
steps: 1. Partly cook rice with onion, carrot and spices.
2. Rub chicken with butter, garlic and spices inside and out.
3. Stuff cavity with rice mixture.
4. Truss and roast at 190 C for 75 min basting every 20 min.
5. Serve with remaining rice and coriander.

name: Arabian Okra Stew
description: Okra braised in spiced tomato sauce with garlic.
steps: 1. Trim okra tops.
2. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
3. Add tomato and chili, cook into thick sauce.
4. Add whole okra and stir gently.
5. Simmer 15 min. Finish with lemon and coriander.

name: Classic Beef Burger
description: Juicy beef patty on a toasted bun with fresh toppings.
steps: 1. Mix minced beef with garlic, egg and seasoning.
2. Shape into patties and grill or pan-fry.
3. Toast bun halves.
4. Add cheese to patty in last minute of cooking.
5. Assemble with tomato, onion and cucumber slices.

name: BBQ Chicken
description: Sticky slow-grilled chicken in tangy BBQ sauce.
steps: 1. Make BBQ sauce by cooking tomato, onion, garlic, chili and butter.
2. Marinate chicken in sauce.
3. Grill chicken on medium heat basting frequently.
4. Turn every 10 min to avoid burning.
5. Finish with squeeze of lemon.

name: Mac and Cheese
description: Creamy baked macaroni smothered in cheddar cheese sauce.
steps: 1. Cook pasta until al dente.
2. Melt butter, fry garlic and onion briefly.
3. Add flour and whisk to make roux.
4. Add liquid and stir until thick, melt in cheese.
5. Mix pasta with sauce, top with cheese and bake 15 min.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Grilled chicken over greens with Caesar dressing.
steps: 1. Grill chicken breast until cooked, slice.
2. Toast cubed bread for croutons.
3. Make dressing with egg yolk, garlic, lemon and cheese.
4. Toss greens with dressing.
5. Top with chicken, croutons and shaved cheese.

name: Potato Wedges
description: Crispy oven-baked potato wedges with garlic seasoning.
steps: 1. Cut potatoes into thick wedges.
2. Toss with oil, garlic, chili and salt.
3. Spread on baking tray skin-side down.
4. Bake at 210 C for 35 min until golden.
5. Toss with onion leaves and a squeeze of lemon.

name: BLT Sandwich
description: Classic toasted bacon, lettuce and tomato sandwich.
steps: 1. Grill bacon until crispy.
2. Toast bread slices.
3. Mash avocado with lemon as spread.
4. Layer bacon and tomato on bread.
5. Add onion leaves and second slice of toast.

name: Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes with strawberry and banana.
steps: 1. Whisk flour, egg, butter and liquid into smooth batter.
2. Let rest 5 min.
3. Cook spoonfuls on buttered pan over medium heat.
4. Flip when bubbles appear on surface.
5. Stack and serve with sliced banana and strawberry.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
description: Buttery toasted sandwich with melted cheese and tomato.
steps: 1. Butter one side of each bread slice.
2. Layer cheese and sliced tomato and onion between slices.
3. Place butter-side down in pan on medium heat.
4. Press gently and cook 3-4 min per side.
5. Slice diagonally and serve hot.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
description: Wholesome homestyle chicken soup with root vegetables.
steps: 1. Simmer chicken with onion and garlic 25 min.
2. Shred chicken and return to pot.
3. Add carrot, potato and corn.
4. Simmer 15 more min.
5. Season and serve with lemon and coriander.

name: Beef Chili
description: Hearty minced beef chili with red beans and tomato.
steps: 1. Brown minced beef in pot.
2. Add onion, garlic and capsicum, cook 5 min.
3. Add tomato and chili, stir well.
4. Add red beans and water.
5. Simmer 35 min, stirring occasionally. Garnish with coriander.

name: Scrambled Eggs and Bacon
description: Soft scrambled eggs with crispy bacon and toast.
steps: 1. Fry bacon until crispy, set aside.
2. Melt butter in pan on low heat.
3. Add beaten eggs and scramble slowly.
4. Remove just before fully set.
5. Serve with bacon, toast and sliced tomato. Top with onion leaves.

name: Corn Chowder
description: Creamy sweet corn soup with potato and bacon.
steps: 1. Fry bacon in butter until crispy, set aside.
2. Fry onion and garlic in the bacon fat.
3. Add potato and corn with water or broth.
4. Simmer 20 min, blend half the soup.
5. Return crumbled bacon. Top with onion leaves.

name: Sausage and Potato Hash
description: Crispy skillet hash of sausage, potato and capsicum.
steps: 1. Dice potato and par-cook in microwave 3 min.
2. Brown sausage slices in oiled skillet.
3. Add potato, capsicum and onion, fry until crispy.
4. Add garlic and cook 2 min.
5. Make wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook until set. Top with onion leaves.

name: Avocado and Chicken Wrap
description: Grilled chicken and avocado rolled in a wheat tortilla.
steps: 1. Season and grill chicken breast, slice.
2. Mash avocado with lemon.
3. Warm flatbread.
4. Spread avocado on bread.
5. Layer chicken, tomato and onion. Garnish with coriander and roll tightly.

name: Potato Salad
description: Classic creamy potato salad with egg and mustard.
steps: 1. Boil potatoes until tender, cube and cool.
2. Hard boil eggs, peel and chop.
3. Dice onion and cucumber.
4. Mix everything with lemon dressing.
5. Garnish with coriander and onion leaves.

name: Fish Tacos
description: Crispy fried fish in tortillas with slaw and lime.
steps: 1. Cut fish into strips and coat in seasoned flour.
2. Fry until golden and crispy.
3. Shred cabbage finely.
4. Warm flatbread.
5. Fill with fish, cabbage, tomato and onion. Squeeze lime and add coriander.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
description: Toasted flatbread filled with spiced chicken and cheese.
steps: 1. Cook diced chicken with capsicum and onion.
2. Lay flatbread in dry pan.
3. Spread chicken mixture on one half.
4. Add cheese and fold over.
5. Cook 3 min per side. Slice and serve with coriander and lime.

name: Loaded Baked Potato
description: Fluffy baked potato loaded with cheese, bacon and butter.
steps: 1. Rub potatoes with oil and salt.
2. Bake at 200 C for 60 min until skin is crispy.
3. Fry bacon until crispy.
4. Split potato open and fluff inside with butter.
5. Top with cheese, bacon, chili and onion leaves.

name: American Coleslaw
description: Crunchy shredded cabbage and carrot salad with creamy dressing.
steps: 1. Shred cabbage finely and grate carrot.
2. Thinly slice onion.
3. Make dressing with lemon juice and oil.
4. Toss vegetables with dressing.
5. Chill 20 min. Garnish with onion leaves and coriander.

name: Tuna Melt
description: Open-faced toasted bread with fish and melted cheese.
steps: 1. Flake cooked fish and mix with onion and lemon.
2. Toast bread until lightly golden.
3. Spread fish mixture on toast.
4. Top with sliced tomato and grated cheese.
5. Grill until cheese melts. Garnish with coriander.

name: Buffalo Chicken Wings
description: Spicy crispy chicken wings in buttery hot sauce.
steps: 1. Season chicken wings and bake at 220 C for 40 min until crispy.
2. Melt butter with garlic and chili.
3. Add lemon juice to the sauce.
4. Toss hot wings in sauce immediately.
5. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Capsicums filled with beef, rice and cheese then baked.
steps: 1. Cut tops off capsicums, remove seeds.
2. Cook minced beef with onion, garlic and tomato.
3. Mix with cooked rice.
4. Fill capsicums, top with cheese.
5. Bake at 180 C for 35 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Egg and Vegetable Frittata
description: Italian-American baked egg dish loaded with vegetables.
steps: 1. Fry garlic, onion, capsicum and mushroom in oven-safe pan.
2. Beat eggs with salt and pour over vegetables.
3. Add tomato slices on top.
4. Sprinkle cheese.
5. Bake at 180 C for 15 min until set.

name: Ham and Cheese Omelette
description: Fluffy folded omelette stuffed with ham and melted cheese.
steps: 1. Beat eggs until foamy.
2. Melt butter in non-stick pan.
3. Pour in eggs and swirl to coat base.
4. Add ham and cheese before fully set.
5. Fold omelette and slide onto plate. Top with tomato and onion leaves.

name: Tofu and Broccoli Bowl
description: Healthy stir-fry of broccoli and tofu with whole grain rice.
steps: 1. Cook rice and set aside.
2. Stir-fry garlic and ginger in oil.
3. Add carrot, broccoli and capsicum.
4. Add tofu cubes and toss on high heat.
5. Serve over rice, garnish with onion leaves.

name: Bacon Potato Soup
description: Thick and creamy potato soup with bacon and cheese.
steps: 1. Fry bacon in butter until crispy, set aside.
2. Cook onion and garlic in same pot.
3. Add potato cubes and water.
4. Simmer 20 min, blend half.
5. Stir in cheese and crumble in bacon. Top with onion leaves.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Casserole
description: One-pan baked chicken thighs with seasonal vegetables.
steps: 1. Brown chicken in butter.
2. Add garlic, onion and tomato.
3. Add carrot and potato with water.
4. Transfer to oven at 180 C for 35 min.
5. Garnish with coriander.

name: Avocado Egg Salad
description: Hard-boiled eggs mashed with avocado and lemon.
steps: 1. Hard boil eggs, peel and chop.
2. Mash avocado with lemon juice.
3. Mix eggs with avocado.
4. Add diced onion, tomato and chili.
5. Garnish with coriander. Serve on bread or as a dip.

name: Sweet Potato Fries
description: Crispy baked sweet potato fries with chili dipping sauce.
steps: 1. Peel and cut sweet potato into thin fries.
2. Toss with oil, garlic and chili.
3. Spread on baking tray in single layer.
4. Bake at 220 C for 25-30 min until crispy.
5. Squeeze lime and garnish with coriander.

name: Beef Ribs
description: Slow-cooked fall-off-the-bone Beef ribs in smoky sauce.
steps: 1. Rub Beef ribs with garlic, chili and salt.
2. Roast covered at 150 C for 90 min.
3. Make sauce from tomato, onion and chili.
4. Uncover, brush with sauce and roast 30 more min.
5. Serve with lemon and coriander.

name: Mushroom Burger
description: Portobello mushroom patty burger with all the trimmings.
steps: 1. Marinate mushrooms with garlic and oil.
2. Grill mushroom caps until tender.
3. Toast bun.
4. Mash avocado as spread.
5. Assemble with mushroom, tomato, onion and cheese.

name: Chicken Club Sandwich
description: Triple-layer toasted sandwich with chicken, bacon and avocado.
steps: 1. Grill or fry chicken breast, slice.
2. Fry bacon until crispy.
3. Toast three slices of bread per sandwich.
4. Mash avocado with lemon.
5. Layer chicken, bacon, tomato and avocado between toasted slices.

name: Beef Steak with Potato
description: Pan-seared beef steak served with garlic roasted potato.
steps: 1. Cube potato and roast with garlic and oil until golden.
2. Season beef well and rest 10 min at room temperature.
3. Sear in very hot pan with butter 3-4 min per side.
4. Rest steak 5 min before slicing.
5. Serve with roast potato, onion leaves and lemon.

name: Watermelon and Cheese Salad
description: Refreshing summer salad of watermelon with cheese and mint.
steps: 1. Cube watermelon and remove seeds.
2. Thinly slice onion and cucumber.
3. Combine watermelon, onion and cucumber.
4. Crumble cheese over top.
5. Dress with lime juice and scatter mint leaves.

name: Roasted Tomato Soup
description: Velvety roasted tomato soup with garlic.
steps: 1. Roast tomatoes, onion and garlic with oil until caramelised.
2. Blend until smooth.
3. Transfer to pot, add water and simmer 10 min.
4. Stir in butter, season.
5. Serve with toasted bread and garnish with coriander.

name: American Breakfast Plate
description: Full breakfast of eggs, sausage, toast and grilled tomato.
steps: 1. Fry sausages until cooked through.
2. Fry eggs in butter to preference.
3. Halve tomatoes and grill cut-side down.
4. Toast bread.
5. Plate everything together and garnish with onion leaves.

name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling spiced chicken strips with onion and capsicum in flatbread.
steps: 1. Slice chicken into strips and marinate with garlic, chili and lime.
2. Sear chicken on very high heat until charred.
3. Remove chicken, fry capsicum and onion strips.
4. Warm flatbread.
5. Fill bread with chicken and vegetables. Top with coriander.

name: Vegetable Burrito
description: Flour tortilla filled with beans, rice and roasted vegetables.
steps: 1. Cook rice and season.
2. Fry garlic, onion, capsicum.
3. Add red beans and tomato, cook 10 min.
4. Warm large flatbread.
5. Layer rice, beans, vegetables and coriander. Roll tightly.

name: Strawberry Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick blended strawberry and banana bowl with toppings.
steps: 1. Blend strawberry and banana until very thick.
2. Pour into bowl.
3. Top with sliced apple and orange segments.
4. Garnish with mint.
5. Serve immediately.

name: Fish Slaw Tacos
description: Pan-fried fish bites with lime slaw in corn tortillas.
steps: 1. Cut fish into bite-sized pieces and season.
2. Pan-fry fish in oil until golden.
3. Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice.
4. Warm bread.
5. Fill with fish and slaw. Top with tomato, onion and coriander.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Classic American chicken soup with noodles and vegetables.
steps: 1. Simmer chicken with onion and garlic 25 min.
2. Remove and shred chicken.
3. Add carrot to broth and cook 10 min.
4. Add noodles and cook until tender.
5. Return chicken. Serve with lemon and coriander.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Spiced minced beef in crispy taco shells with fresh toppings.
steps: 1. Brown minced beef with onion, chili and garlic.
2. Season well and cook until dry.
3. Warm flatbread.
4. Fill with beef, tomato and onion.
5. Top with cheese, squeeze lime and add coriander.

name: Caprese Salad
description: Italian-American salad of tomato, cheese and fresh basil.
steps: 1. Slice tomato and cheese into rounds.
2. Slice cucumber.
3. Alternate tomato, cheese and cucumber slices.
4. Drizzle with oil and lemon juice.
5. Scatter mint and onion leaves over top.

name: Chicken and Rice Casserole
description: One-pan baked chicken thighs on a bed of seasoned rice.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in butter.
2. Add carrot and tomato, cook 5 min.
3. Add rice and water to baking dish.
4. Nestle seasoned chicken on top.
5. Bake covered at 180 C for 50 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Broccoli Cheese Soup
description: Smooth and comforting broccoli and cheese soup.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in butter.
2. Add potato and broccoli.
3. Cover with water and simmer 15 min.
4. Blend until smooth.
5. Stir in cheese until melted. Garnish with coriander.

name: Beef Stir-fry
description: Quick Asian-American Beef stir-fry with colourful vegetables.
steps: 1. Slice Beef thinly.
2. Stir-fry garlic and ginger in hot oil.
3. Add Beef and cook on high heat until browned.
4. Add carrot, broccoli, capsicum and onion.
5. Toss 3 min and garnish with onion leaves.

name: Avocado Tomato Salsa
description: Fresh chunky guacamole-style salsa with tomato and lime.
steps: 1. Dice avocado, tomato and onion.
2. Mince garlic and chili finely.
3. Combine everything in a bowl.
4. Squeeze lime juice over and mix.
5. Season and garnish with coriander. Serve with flatbread.

name: BBQ Beef Sandwich
description: Slow-cooked pulled Beef on toasted bun with coleslaw.
steps: 1. Season Beef and slow roast at 150 C for 2 hours.
2. Pull meat apart with forks.
3. Make quick sauce with tomato, garlic and chili.
4. Toss Beef in sauce.
5. Pile on toasted bread with shredded cabbage, onion and lemon.

name: Bacon and Vegetable Omelette
description: Fluffy omelette packed with bacon, capsicum and onion.
steps: 1. Fry bacon until crispy, crumble.
2. Fry capsicum and onion in butter.
3. Beat eggs and pour over vegetables.
4. Scatter bacon over, add tomato slices.
5. Fold and cook through. Top with onion leaves.

name: Chicken and Avocado Salad
description: Grilled chicken with avocado, cucumber and lemon dressing.
steps: 1. Grill chicken and slice.
2. Cube avocado and cucumber.
3. Slice tomato and onion.
4. Dress everything with lemon juice and oil.
5. Toss gently and garnish with coriander.

name: Beef and Mushroom Stew
description: Rich and hearty beef and mushroom stew with potato.
steps: 1. Brown beef in batches.
2. Fry onion, garlic and mushroom.
3. Add tomato and return beef with water.
4. Simmer 45 min.
5. Add potato and carrot, cook 20 more min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Sweet Potato and Bean Bowl
description: Roasted sweet potato over black lentils and rice.
steps: 1. Cube sweet potato and roast with oil at 200 C for 25 min.
2. Cook black lentils with garlic and onion.
3. Cook rice.
4. Assemble bowl with rice, lentils and sweet potato.
5. Add sliced avocado, squeeze lime and garnish with coriander.

name: Corn and Capsicum Salsa
description: Fresh and smoky corn salsa with capsicum and lime.
steps: 1. Grill or char corn kernels.
2. Dice capsicum, tomato and onion.
3. Combine corn with vegetables.
4. Squeeze lime over and add chili.
5. Toss with coriander and season.

name: Pan-Seared Fish with Vegetables
description: Pan-seared fish fillet with roasted seasonal vegetables.
steps: 1. Season fish fillet with garlic and lemon.
2. Pan-sear in butter 4 min per side.
3. Roast broccoli and carrot in oven.
4. Plate fish with roasted vegetables.
5. Finish with butter and onion leaves.

name: Minestrone Vegetable Soup
description: Simple hearty minestrone-style vegetable soup.
steps: 1. Fry onion and garlic in oil.
2. Add carrot and potato, stir 3 min.
3. Add tomato and cabbage with water.
4. Simmer 20 min.
5. Season and serve with toasted bread and coriander.

name: Crab and Fish Cakes
description: Pan-fried fish and crab cakes with lemon herb dipping sauce.
steps: 1. Flake fish and mix with crab meat.
2. Add egg, breadcrumbs, onion, garlic and coriander.
3. Shape into patties.
4. Pan-fry in oil 4 min per side until golden.
5. Serve with lemon wedges and coriander dip.

name: Garden Omelette
description: Light omelette with broccoli, mushroom and cheese.
steps: 1. Blanch broccoli briefly.
2. Fry mushroom and onion in butter.
3. Beat eggs and pour into pan.
4. Add broccoli, mushroom and cheese before setting.
5. Fold and serve garnished with onion leaves.

name: Beef Rice Bowl
description: Korean-American inspired beef and vegetable rice bowl.
steps: 1. Cook rice and keep warm.
2. Stir-fry garlic, ginger and onion.
3. Add thinly sliced beef and cook on high heat.
4. Add carrot and toss.
5. Serve beef over rice, top with fried egg and onion leaves.

name: Orange Chicken
description: Crispy chicken tossed in tangy orange sauce.
steps: 1. Coat chicken pieces in flour and fry until crispy.
2. Squeeze orange juice into pan with garlic and ginger.
3. Add chili and reduce to a glaze.
4. Toss crispy chicken in sauce.
5. Serve over rice and garnish with onion leaves.

name: Chicken and Corn Chowder
description: Thick and creamy chicken chowder with sweet corn.
steps: 1. Cook diced chicken in butter with onion and garlic.
2. Add corn, potato and water.
3. Simmer 20 min.
4. Blend a portion to thicken.
5. Season and garnish with onion leaves.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
description: Creamy egg salad with onion and cucumber on toasted bread.
steps: 1. Hard boil eggs, peel and chop.
2. Mix with diced onion and cucumber.
3. Dress with lemon juice and chili.
4. Toast bread.
5. Pile egg salad on toast and garnish with coriander.

name: Sausage Pasta
description: Pasta tossed with sausage, tomato and cheese.
steps: 1. Cook pasta in salted water until al dente.
2. Slice sausage and brown in pan.
3. Fry garlic, onion and capsicum.
4. Add tomato and simmer 10 min.
5. Toss pasta in sauce, top with cheese and coriander.

name: Chicken Avocado Toast
description: Grilled chicken on avocado toast with poached egg.
steps: 1. Grill chicken breast and slice.
2. Mash avocado with lemon and chili.
3. Toast bread.
4. Poach egg in simmering water.
5. Spread avocado, top with chicken and poached egg. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Beef and Vegetable Stir-fry
description: Quick high-heat beef stir-fry with broccoli and capsicum.
steps: 1. Slice beef thinly against the grain.
2. Stir-fry garlic and ginger in very hot oil.
3. Add beef and sear quickly.
4. Add broccoli, capsicum and onion.
5. Toss 3 min. Serve over rice and garnish with onion leaves.

name: Mushroom and Cheese Quesadilla
description: Crispy flatbread filled with garlic mushroom and melted cheese.
steps: 1. Fry garlic, onion, mushroom and capsicum.
2. Lay flatbread in dry pan.
3. Add mushroom mixture on one half.
4. Top with cheese and fold over.
5. Cook 3 min per side. Top with onion leaves.

name: Apple and Pear Salad
description: Crisp autumn fruit salad with cheese and mint dressing.
steps: 1. Slice apple and pear thinly.
2. Toss with lemon juice to prevent browning.
3. Crumble cheese over.
4. Garnish with mint and onion leaves.
5. Drizzle with lemon and serve immediately.

name: Chicken Fried Rice Bowl
description: American takeout-style chicken fried rice with vegetables.
steps: 1. Cook rice ahead and cool.
2. Stir-fry garlic and onion.
3. Add chicken and cook through.
4. Add carrot and green lentils, scramble in egg.
5. Toss in rice on high heat. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Pulled Chicken Sandwich
description: Slow-cooked shredded chicken in smoky tomato sauce on a bun.
steps: 1. Simmer whole chicken with garlic and onion 40 min.
2. Shred meat.
3. Cook tomato, garlic and chili into BBQ-style sauce.
4. Toss chicken in sauce.
5. Pile on bread with shredded cabbage and squeeze lemon.

name: Fruit Parfait
description: Layered fresh fruit with mint.
steps: 1. Slice all fruits.
2. Layer fruits alternately in glasses.
3. Repeat layers.
4. Top with a final fruit layer.
5. Garnish with fresh mint.

name: Crab Boil
description: Spiced crab meat boiled with corn and potato.
steps: 1. Boil water with garlic, onion and chili.
2. Add potato and corn, cook 10 min.
3. Add crab meat and cook 5 more min.
4. Drain and spread on table.
5. Squeeze lemon over and scatter coriander.

name: Loaded Nachos
description: Tortilla chips loaded with beef, beans, cheese and salsa.
steps: 1. Brown minced beef with onion and chili.
2. Add red beans and warm through.
3. Spread chips on baking tray.
4. Top with beef mixture and cheese.
5. Bake 10 min. Top with tomato, coriander and squeeze lime.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
description: Grilled chicken and cheese wrapped in flatbread.
steps: 1. Grill chicken and slice.
2. Make quick dressing from garlic and lemon.
3. Warm flatbread.
4. Layer chicken, cheese, tomato and onion.
5. Drizzle dressing and roll. Garnish with coriander.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Tender spiced Beef in flatbread with fresh toppings.
steps: 1. Slice Beef thinly and marinate with chili and lime.
2. Grill Beef on high heat until charred.
3. Warm flatbread.
4. Fill with Beef, onion and capsicum.
5. Top with tomato and coriander. Squeeze lime.

name: Pancake Stack with Fruit
description: Tall stack of fluffy pancakes topped with fresh mixed fruit.
steps: 1. Make pancake batter with flour, egg and butter.
2. Cook golden pancakes on buttered pan.
3. Slice all fruits.
4. Stack pancakes on plate.
5. Top generously with mixed fruit.

name: Avocado Chicken Bowl
description: Grilled chicken rice bowl with avocado, corn and lime.
steps: 1. Cook rice and keep warm.
2. Season and grill chicken, slice.
3. Char corn kernels in dry pan.
4. Slice avocado and tomato.
5. Assemble bowl, squeeze lime and garnish with coriander.

name: Baked Meatballs
description: Baked minced meat meatballs in rich tomato sauce.
steps: 1. Mix minced meat with egg, breadcrumbs, garlic and coriander.
2. Roll into balls and bake at 200 C for 20 min.
3. Fry onion and garlic for sauce.
4. Add tomato and chili, simmer 10 min.
5. Add meatballs to sauce and simmer 5 min.

name: Egg Drop Soup
description: Light Chinese-American egg drop soup with ginger.
steps: 1. Bring broth to simmer with garlic and ginger.
2. Add corn and tofu, cook 5 min.
3. Beat eggs well.
4. Slowly drizzle eggs into simmering soup while stirring.
5. Garnish with onion leaves and coriander.

name: Flatbread Veggie Pizza
description: Flatbread topped with tomato sauce, cheese and vegetables.
steps: 1. Spread tomato sauce on flatbread.
2. Fry garlic, onion, capsicum and mushroom briefly.
3. Spread vegetables over bread.
4. Top with grated cheese.
5. Bake at 220 C for 12 min. Garnish with coriander.

name: Fish and Corn Soup
description: Creamy fish and sweet corn soup.
steps: 1. Cook onion and garlic in butter.
2. Add potato and corn with water.
3. Simmer 15 min until potato is soft.
4. Add flaked fish and cook 5 min.
5. Finish with lemon and onion leaves.

name: Beef and Bean Burrito
description: Warm flour tortilla packed with beef, beans and cheese.
steps: 1. Brown minced beef with onion.
2. Add red beans and tomato, simmer 10 min.
3. Cook rice.
4. Warm flatbread.
5. Layer rice, beef mixture and cheese. Add tomato and coriander. Roll tightly.

name: Grilled Vegetable Platter
description: Seasonal vegetables chargrilled with herbs and lemon.
steps: 1. Cut all vegetables into grill-friendly pieces.
2. Marinate with garlic and oil.
3. Grill on high heat until charred marks appear.
4. Turn and grill other side.
5. Finish with lemon juice and coriander.

name: Chicken and Broccoli Bake
description: One-pan baked chicken thighs with broccoli in cheese sauce.
steps: 1. Brown chicken in oven-safe pan.
2. Add garlic, onion and tomato.
3. Transfer to oven at 190 C for 20 min.
4. Add broccoli florets and cheese.
5. Bake 15 more min until cheese is golden.

name: Beef Pasta Sauce
description: American-style bolognese with minced beef and tomato.
steps: 1. Cook pasta separately.
2. Brown minced meat.
3. Fry onion, garlic and capsicum.
4. Add tomato and chili, simmer 20 min.
5. Toss pasta in sauce and garnish with coriander.

name: Pear and Apple Crisp
description: Baked autumn fruit topped with a buttery crumble.
steps: 1. Peel and slice pear and apple, toss with lemon.
2. Arrange in baking dish.
3. Mix flour with butter to form crumble.
4. Spread crumble over fruit.
5. Bake at 180 C for 35 min until golden.

name: Caramelised Banana Dessert
description: Pan-caramelised banana with butter and orange zest.
steps: 1. Slice bananas lengthwise.
2. Melt butter in pan.
3. Add banana and cook until golden.
4. Squeeze orange juice and lemon over.
5. Simmer 3 min until syrupy. Serve warm.

name: Chicken Salad Sandwich
description: Poached chicken salad with vegetables on toasted bread.
steps: 1. Poach chicken until cooked, cool and shred.
2. Mix with diced onion and cucumber.
3. Dress with lemon juice.
4. Toast bread.
5. Pile chicken salad on toast, add tomato and coriander.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
description: American Chinese-style vegetable fried rice with egg.
steps: 1. Cook rice ahead and cool.
2. Scramble egg and set aside.
3. Fry garlic and onion.
4. Add carrot, green lentils and capsicum.
5. Toss in rice and egg on high heat. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Chicken and Sweet Potato Stew
description: Comforting chicken stew with sweet potato and carrot.
steps: 1. Brown chicken with onion and garlic.
2. Add ginger and tomato, cook 5 min.
3. Add sweet potato and carrot with water.
4. Simmer 30 min until tender.
5. Garnish with coriander.

name: Beef and Potato Hash
description: Crispy diced beef and potato skillet breakfast.
steps: 1. Dice beef and potato into small cubes.
2. Fry beef until browned.
3. Add potato, onion and capsicum, cook until crispy.
4. Add garlic and season.
5. Make wells, fry eggs in. Garnish with onion leaves.

name: Fish and Chips
description: Classic battered fish with thick-cut potato fries.
steps: 1. Cut potato into thick chips and bake at 210 C for 30 min.
2. Make batter with flour, egg and water.
3. Coat fish in batter.
4. Deep fry until golden and crispy.
5. Serve with chips, lemon and chili. Top with onion leaves.

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie
description: Thick blended fruit smoothie with strawberry and banana.
steps: 1. Peel banana and hull strawberries.
2. Add to blender with orange juice.
3. Add lemon juice.
4. Blend until very smooth.
5. Pour and garnish with mint.

name: Chicken and Mushroom Pasta
description: Creamy chicken and mushroom pasta with garlic.
steps: 1. Cook pasta until al dente.
2. Cook diced chicken in butter.
3. Add garlic, onion and mushroom.
4. Make creamy sauce and toss with pasta.
5. Top with cheese and coriander.

name: Ham and Potato Soup
description: Hearty ham and potato soup with onion and cheese.
steps: 1. Fry ham with onion and garlic in butter.
2. Add potato and carrot.
3. Cover with water and simmer 20 min.
4. Blend partially for creamy texture.
5. Stir in cheese and top with onion leaves.

name: Spicy Chicken Rice Bowl
description: Chili-glazed chicken over white rice with fresh toppings.
steps: 1. Cook rice.
2. Mix chili, garlic and lime for marinade.
3. Cook marinated chicken.
4. Slice cucumber and tomato.
5. Serve chicken over rice with vegetables. Top with onion leaves.

name: Watermelon Salad with Cheese
description: Sweet watermelon salad with salty cheese and fresh herbs.
steps: 1. Cube watermelon and slice cucumber.
2. Thinly slice onion.
3. Combine in a bowl.
4. Crumble cheese over.
5. Dress with lime, add chili and mint.

name: Sausage and Vegetable Skillet
description: One-pan sausage and vegetable skillet dinner.
steps: 1. Slice sausage into rounds and brown in pan.
2. Add potato and cook until starting to crisp.
3. Add onion, capsicum and garlic.
4. Add tomato and stir everything together.
5. Cover and cook 10 min. Garnish with coriander.
